subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which context-overflow facts should OpenClaw show directly to users, and how should session/channel identifiers be redacted?
rationale: Current code already carries model, provider, token, budget, route, and session facts, but exposing exact identifiers and counts changes privacy and support behavior that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Show redacted diagnostics
options.body: Expose provider/model, effective model limit or context budget, observed or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted channel/session label while keeping raw identifiers in logs.

options.title: Keep specifics operator-only
options.body: Leave chat copy generic and document the log or status path operators should use for detailed context-pressure facts.

options.title: Fold into broader visibility work
options.body: Defer this issue until a broader context-visibility design decides shared UI, logs, and channel-message behavior together.

recommendation.title: Show redacted diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose provider/model, effective model limit or context budget, observed or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted channel/session label while keeping raw identifiers in logs.
